subject: history
concept: Understanding the space race as an example of technological and scientific competition between nations
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sequences key space-race milestone cards (first satellite, first human in space, moon landing) in order
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a space-race achievement to the nation responsible for it
exercise.abstract: Student explains why the space race mattered beyond just scientific achievement

misconception_flags: places major space-race milestones out of chronological order

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
